judgment.reasoning_summary: The problem requires finding the minimum number of weights to measure all integer weights from 1 kg to 121 kg on a balance scale, with each weight placed on one side. This is a classic problem that can be solved using the concept of powers of 3, as each weight can be placed on either side or not used at all, effectively giving us a base-3 system. The weights needed are 1, 3, 9, 27, and 81 kg, which cover all weights up to 121 kg (1 + 3 + 9 + 27 + 81 = 121).
